result.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
result.summary: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Agent S4：由 meta-agent 在无成功标签的合成任务轨迹上构建并修订「界面＋使用知识」仓库，再用种群进化按验证任务表现筛选仓库，以提升电脑使用智能体的自主接口设计能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其从轨迹中无标签地归纳可复用操作接口与「何时使用」知识，可能为 LVR 中学习视觉证据获取动作（LOOK）及工具调用选择提供方法线索，但对象是 GUI 操作而非多模态推理状态，可迁移性需核查。
